css: .markdown-body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; color: #333; max-width: none; } h1 { color: #2E5BBA; border-bottom: 3px solid #2E5BBA; } .toc-container { background: transparent; padding: 0; margin: 20px 0; border: none; } .toc-container h2 { color: #2E5BBA; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 30px; border-bottom: 2px solid #2E5BBA; padding-bottom: 10px; } .toc-container table { border: none !important; border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; margin: 0; background: transparent; } .toc-container tbody { border: none !important; } .toc-container tr { border: none !important; background: transparent; } .toc-container td { border: none !important; padding: 6px 0; vertical-align: top; background: transparent !important; } .toc-container td:nth-child(1) { font-weight: bold; width: 8%; text-align: left; color: #2E5BBA; font-size: 12px; padding-right: 20px; } .toc-container td:nth-child(2) { width: 82%; padding-left: 0; } .toc-container td:nth-child(2) a { text-decoration: none; color: #333; font-weight: 500; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .toc-container td:nth-child(2) a:hover { color: #2E5BBA; text-decoration: underline; } .toc-container td:nth-child(3) { width: 10%; text-align: right; font-weight: normal; color: #666; padding-left: 50px; } table:not(.toc-container table) { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; margin: 10px 0; } table:not(.toc-container table) th { background-color: #f8f9fa; font-weight: bold; } table:not(.toc-container table) th, table:not(.toc-container table) td { border: 1px solid #dee2e6; padding: 8px; text-align: left; } table:not(.toc-container table) tr:nth-child(even) { background-color: #f9f9f9; } code { background-color: #f1f3f4; padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 90%; color: #d73a49; } pre { background-color: #f8f9fa; border: 1px solid #e1e4e8; padding: 16px; border-radius: 6px;
